title: muellera moniliformis
intro: Muellera moniliformis, commonly known as Indian mulberry, is a plant species that belongs to the family Moraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diabetes, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Muellera moniliformis include its ability to modulate blood sugar levels, reduce fever, and exhibit wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents of Muellera moniliformis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
